test_status: exploratory follow-up on previously inspected 2020 Q3-Q4
scope: Full versus WeightedSVQR, TargetSVQR, and HistGBR on sites 1--6
unit: non-overlapping seven-day calendar blocks anchored at the calendar date of the first retained test observation
estimand: mean paired squared-error difference in MW^2 after averaging algorithmic seeds within each forecast; Full minus comparator
bootstrap: 10,000 equal-probability block resamples; each replicate is the sum of sampled block losses divided by the sum of sampled block counts
test: 99,999 two-sided block sign flips of block loss sums divided by the fixed total observation count
multiplicity: Holm adjustment over all 18 site-comparator tests
interpretation: negative effects favor Full; temporal blocks are an analysis assumption, not independent-event or new-dataset replication
